project.title: Integrated analysis of airborne fungal and bryophyte communities
project.description: Next-generation sequencing (NGS) approaches are opening new avenues for understanding the composition and dynamics of the airborne microbiome. By integrating microscopic analysis, cultivation-based methods, qPCR, and NGS, and by combining these approaches with volumetric aerobiological sampling across different environments, this study contributes to a more comprehensive characterization of airborne biological particles. In particular, it provides new insights into the diversity and spatio-temporal variability of fungal communities and bryophyte spores in urban air.
project.center_name: Faculty of Natural Sciences, Comenius University in Bratislava

samples: B_June-Oct_2025_VP UK, KB UK, SJK, ZB
explicit urban setting at sample level

Bioaerosol sampling was performed using a portable volumetric personal sampler operated for 2 hours, with particles collected onto a Melinex adhesive tape coated with Vaseline and mounted on a microscopic slide.
